name: The Remarkables
locality: The Remarkables range, above the Kawarau valley near Frankton, Queenstown

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate ski-area base position (no village; visitors stay in Queenstown)
Search summary: base 1,586 m, summit 1,943 m, vertical 357 m (attribution uncertain).

Search summary: three basins covering 220 hectares (kept in this note) with eight lifts — 4 chairlifts and 4 magic carpets (other) — and about 20 km of runs (the km figure likely from skiresort.info); another result in the same summary said 7 lifts. Season id 2025-26.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'.

character: A Queenstown ski area spread over three basins on the Remarkables range, reached by a winding mountain access road and operated by NZSki. It has high-speed six-seat and quad chairlifts and is included on the Ikon Pass.
learning: Reference note: learner areas with magic carpets and an NZSki snowsports school are at the base; confirm 2027 lesson products.

source.note: Winter 2026: opening announced for Sat 27 Jun 2026 after fresh snowfall and a snowmaking window (SnowBrains; also https://snowfall.co.nz/news/the-remarkables-opening-day-2026-update/). Closing: scheduled Sun 11 Oct 2026 (shared research notes, https://www.onthesnow.com/new-zealand/projected-closing) — still ahead on 2026-09-30. Planned closing day 2026-10-11 (not yet happened as of 2026-09-30).
Winter 2025 published season dates: 14 Jun – 12 Oct 2025 (scheduled dates; actual days may have differed).

season.typicalText: Usually mid-June to mid-October; in 2026 the opening slipped to 27 Jun because of a late start to winter.
season.notes: Southern Hemisphere: Piste season id 2026-27 is the June–October 2027 winter (the one the 2026-27 Ikon and Epic passes cover); 2025-26 is the 2026 winter and 2024-25 the 2025 winter. No 2027 opening or closing date was found as of 2026-09-30 (NZSki's 2027 3 Peak Pass was still listed as 'Coming Soon' — https://www.theremarkables.co.nz/passes-packages/). OnTheSnow labels the 2026 NZ winter '2026/2027', so its 'projected' dates describe winter 2026, not 2027.  Official homepage (2026-10-03) lists a "Closing Day & Pond Skim" to send off the 2026 season and a 2027 Season Pass Super Early Bird sale; 2027 dates not announced. The proposed Doolans expansion would add 262 ha (to 711 ha).
